metadata.name: prize_escrow
metadata.description: make.fun prize escrow: a funded vault per competition, a bonded and challengeable result, k-of-n regrader attestations, a Squads arbiter, and merkle self-claims

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: The proposed admin takes the Config, unless its key is revoked.

instructions.name: arbiter_resolve
docs: The Config's arbiter chooses which result of a Frozen escrow applies, the posted one or a
challenge's alternative at least one named regrader voted for (its Challenge PDA passed
in), as stored, naming its commitment; the chosen side takes every bond, and the escrow is
Claimable on its result. Keeping the posted result clears an alternative a quorum recorded.

accounts.name: arbiter
docs: Config.arbiter (every escrow names it at open; a Config rotate moves every escrow to the new
one): a Squads v4 vault PDA, which can only sign through the multisig's CPI, or a key.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for its balance: the chosen side's total must not exceed it.

accounts.name: resolver
docs: Every bond when the posted result is chosen.

accounts.name: challenge
docs: The chosen Challenge PDA (choice Alternative): its escrow this one, its alt_commitment the
instruction's `commitment`. Omitted when the posted result is chosen.

accounts.name: challenger
docs: handler). Every bond when its alternative is chosen; omitted with the challenge.

accounts.name: config
docs: The arbiter, the stop clock, the PayoutStop, the guardian's freeze and the revoked keys.

instructions.name: attest
docs: A named regrader backs the posted result or one challenge's (its Challenge PDA passed in)
by its commitment, once, before attest_deadline. Counts the vote, and records the
challenge whose votes reach k as the winning alternative; the status is settle's to change.

accounts.name: regrader
docs: One of the escrow's named regraders; pays the attestation's rent.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: One per regrader per escrow, so a regrader votes once.

accounts.name: challenge
docs: The Challenge PDA whose commitment the vote names; omitted for a vote on the posted result.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock and the revoked keys.

instructions.name: challenge_commit
docs: A challenge's first step: anyone bonds a commit to sha256(alt_commitment || challenger ||
salt) before challenge_deadline, at the PDA ["commit", escrow, challenger, hash].

accounts.name: challenger
docs: Anyone: pays the SOL bond into the escrow account and the commit's rent.

accounts.name: commit
docs: One per (escrow, challenger, hash): the challenger in the seeds keeps a copied hash at
another address.

instructions.name: challenge_reveal
docs: A challenge's second step: the commit's challenger reveals `salt` and the alternative
result (document hash, payout root and total, the total at most the vault balance) whose
commitment (`alt_commitment`, its result_commitment) differs from the posted one and from
every earlier challenge's, in a slot after the commit's and before challenge_deadline +
reveal_grace, into its own Challenge PDA ["challenge", escrow, alt_commitment]. The first
makes the escrow Disputed and opens the attestation window; a later one joins the dispute.

accounts.name: challenger
docs: The commit's challenger: pays the Challenge PDA's rent and takes the commit's back.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for its balance: the alternative's total must not exceed it, so a quorum for the
alternative can always apply it.

accounts.name: commit
docs: The challenger's commit, closed here (its rent back to the challenger).

accounts.name: challenge
docs: One per distinct alternative: `init` refuses a commitment already challenged.

instructions.name: claim
docs: The claimant takes `amount` (0 = all that is left) of its leaf's `total_amount` from
the vault into its own token account, while Claimable and before claim_deadline, within
the flow bucket. It needs the compliance key's co-signature or a cleared request.

accounts.name: claimant
docs: The winner: signs for its own leaf.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the fees and any rent; separate from the claimant, so a claim can be gasless.

accounts.name: compliance
docs: escrow.compliance co-signing a screened claim. Omitted on the lapse path (a request whose
hold window passed with no hold) and when the escrow has no compliance gate.

accounts.name: claimant_token_account
docs: The claimant's own associated token account (the destination owner pin).

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock, the PayoutStop, the guardian's freeze, the revoked keys and the flow
bucket (written: the claim takes from it).

instructions.name: close_attestation
docs: Permissionless: closes a regrader's Attestation once its escrow is Closed, its rent back
to the regrader.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: The vote, at its own PDA ["attestation", escrow, regrader] (so this escrow's, and the
regrader account's: ConstraintSeeds for any other), closed into its regrader.

accounts.name: regrader
docs: The regrader who voted and paid the rent: the rent goes back to it.

instructions.name: close_challenge
docs: Permissionless: closes a Challenge PDA once its dispute is over (Claimable or Closed), its
rent back to its challenger, and its bond too after a refund that decided nothing.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Pays back a bond a refund left held.

accounts.name: challenger
docs: Its rent back, and its bond after a refund that decided nothing.

instructions.name: close_commit
docs: Permissionless: closes a commit never revealed once its escrow decided (Claimable or
Closed), its bond and rent back to its own challenger.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Pays the commit's bond back.

instructions.name: close_receipt
docs: The claimant closes its receipt after the escrow is Closed and takes the rent back.

accounts.name: claimant
docs: The receipt's claimant; gets the rent back.

instructions.name: commit_entries
docs: The resolver fixes the entries root of at least one entry, once, before entries_deadline,
while Open.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock and the revoked keys.

instructions.name: escalate
docs: The guardian hands an undecided (Challengeable or Disputed) escrow to the arbiter: Frozen.
A recorded quorum binds once settle may apply it, and is refused from then on
(QuorumRecorded): at challenge_deadline for the posted result, at attest_deadline for a
challenge's alternative. An unchallenged result binds once its challenge window is over
(challenge_deadline, or the reveal grace's end while a commit is pending), and is refused
from then on too (UnchallengedResultBinds).

instructions.name: extend_freeze
docs: The admin moves the lapse of an escrow's freeze later.

instructions.name: extend_stop
docs: The admin moves the lapse of the stop in force later.

instructions.name: fund
docs: The sponsor adds `amount` to the vault while the escrow is Open, within the caps.

accounts.name: config
docs: The caps (open_value grows by the deposit) and the stop.

instructions.name: hold
docs: The compliance key holds `claimant`'s claim with a HOLD_* reason, creating the receipt
if needed.

accounts.name: compliance
docs: escrow.compliance; pays the receipt's rent when the claimant has none yet.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock and the revoked keys.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: The program's upgrade authority creates the Config at ["config"], once.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority (its ProgramData's upgrade_authority_address); pays the
rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: PDA ["config"]: `init`, so it is created once.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData account, ["<program id>"] under the upgradeable loader.

instructions.name: open_escrow
docs: Create the escrow for `competition_id` at the PDA ["escrow", sponsor, competition_id], pin
the mint and its decimals, store the terms (held to EscrowTerms::validate's bounds, the
bond to bond_floor of the cluster's rent, and to the Config's open policy and caps) and
rules_sha256, and move `terms.total` from the sponsor into the vault (the vault must grow
by exactly that much). Classic Token program only.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: Funds the vault from `sponsor_token_account` and pays the rent.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: PDA ["escrow", sponsor, competition_id]: one sponsor cannot open (squat) another's address.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The prize mint, owned by the classic Token program (no Token-2022, so no transfer hook).

accounts.name: vault
docs: The escrow's associated token account. init_if_needed, so a vault someone created ahead
of time cannot block the open.

accounts.name: config
docs: The open policy, the caps (open_value grows by the deposit) and the stop.

instructions.name: post_result
docs: The resolver posts the payout root, the result and kit hashes and the total with its SOL
bond, at or after final_end and before resolve_deadline, once the entries root is
committed; 0 < `total` <= the vault balance. Stores the result commitment and opens the
challenge window (Challengeable).

accounts.name: resolver
docs: Posts the result and pays the SOL bond into the escrow account.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for its balance: the posted total must not exceed it.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock and the revoked keys.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: The admin names its successor (accept_admin completes the move).

instructions.name: refund
docs: Permissionless: sweeps the vault to refund_to and closes it, leaving the escrow Closed and
the resolver's bond (if still held) returned; challengers' bonds still held wait for
close_challenge. Allowed when Claimable past claim_deadline (whatever hard_deadline says),
Open past resolve_deadline, or any other status past hard_deadline, except a Disputed
escrow whose quorum is recorded (QuorumRecorded): settle applies it, past hard_deadline too.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the fees and, if needed, refund_to's token account rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock, the PayoutStop, the guardian's freeze, and the global cap's counter
(written: the escrow's deposit comes off open_value).

instructions.name: release_hold
docs: The compliance key releases `claimant`'s hold.

accounts.name: config
docs: The revoked keys.

instructions.name: request_claim
docs: The claimant proves its leaf and starts the hold window: with no hold placed before it
passes, the claim clears without the compliance co-signature. Refused, as claim is, while
a PayoutStop or the guardian's freeze of the escrow is in force.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the receipt's rent; may differ from the claimant.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock and the revoked keys.

instructions.name: rotate_role
docs: The admin replaces an escrow's resolver, compliance key or one regrader.

accounts.name: old_attestation
docs: handler): a regrader seat rotates only while it has not voted. Omitted for the resolver
and the compliance key.

instructions.name: set_allowed
docs: The admin adds a key to an allowlist (mints, sponsors, the regrader registry) or takes it
off.

instructions.name: set_config_role
docs: The admin replaces the guardian or the arbiter with a key that is not revoked.

instructions.name: set_floors
docs: The admin sets the window floors and the reveal grace.

instructions.name: set_freeze
docs: The guardian freezes one escrow, for 7 days of the global clock; the admin unfreezes it.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: The admin sets the caps, the flow bucket, min_bond and max_house_regraders.

instructions.name: set_min_regraders
docs: The admin sets the panel floor: the fewest regraders (1 to MAX_REGRADERS) an escrow opened
after it may name.

instructions.name: set_revoked
docs: The guardian revokes a key (refused everywhere after); the admin unrevokes it.

instructions.name: set_stop
docs: The guardian raises the stop (Normal, IntakeStop, PayoutStop), for 7 days, or until the
later lapse of the stop in force; the admin sets any level, Normal included.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless, never before challenge_deadline (nor before the reveal grace ends while a
commit is pending): ends an unchallenged window (Claimable) or a dispute: Claimable on the
posted result's quorum, Claimable on the winning challenge's alternative (applied) on its
quorum once attest_deadline (challenge_deadline + attest_window) is reached, Frozen on no
quorum by attest_deadline. The winning side takes every bond.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for its balance: an alternative a quorum applies must not total more than it holds.

accounts.name: resolver
docs: Its bond back, and every challenger's too when the posted result stands.

accounts.name: challenger
docs: the regraders' quorum backed (attest recorded it). Every bond when that alternative is
applied; omitted when no alternative won, and may be whenever nothing is paid to it.

accounts.name: config
docs: The stop clock, the PayoutStop and the guardian's freeze.

errors.name: UnauthorizedArbiter
errors.msg: The signer is not this escrow's arbiter

errors.name: NotARegrader

errors.name: InvalidStatus

errors.name: ChallengeWindowClosed

errors.name: ClaimWindowClosed

errors.name: ClaimWindowNotElapsed
errors.msg: The claim window has not elapsed yet

errors.name: AttestWindowOpen

errors.name: AttestWindowClosed

errors.name: Overfunded

errors.name: ExceedsAllocation

errors.name: NothingToClaim

errors.name: MintMismatch

errors.name: DecimalsMismatch

errors.name: UnsupportedTokenProgram

errors.name: BondMismatch

errors.name: HeldForCompliance

errors.name: HoldWindowOpen

errors.name: EntriesAlreadyCommitted
errors.msg: The entries root has already been committed

errors.name: UnauthorizedSponsor

errors.name: UnauthorizedCompliance

errors.name: InvalidDeadlines

errors.name: InvalidWindow

errors.name: InvalidAmount

errors.name: InvalidHoldReason
errors.msg: The hold reason is not one of sanctions, geo, tax form required or review

errors.name: EntriesWindowClosed
errors.msg: The entries deadline has passed

errors.name: ResolveWindowClosed
errors.msg: The resolve deadline has passed

errors.name: NotHeld
errors.msg: This claim is not held

errors.name: AlreadyRequested
errors.msg: This claim has already been requested

errors.name: FinalNotEnded
errors.msg: The competition's final phase has not ended yet

errors.name: EntriesNotCommitted

errors.name: ClaimWindowTooShort

errors.name: HardDeadlineTooEarly
errors.msg: The hard deadline must be at least every window and ARBITER_SLACK after the resolve deadline

errors.name: BondBelowFloor

errors.name: ChallengeMismatch

errors.name: AlternativeUnbacked
errors.msg: No named regrader voted for this alternative: the arbiter chooses the posted result or an alternative a regrader backed

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority can initialise the config

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin
errors.msg: The signer is not the config's admin

errors.name: UnauthorizedGuardian

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: The signer is not the admin the config's admin proposed

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: A config value is out of bounds

errors.name: KeyRevoked
errors.msg: This key is revoked: its signature is refused everywhere until the admin unrevokes it

errors.name: CannotRevokeAdmin
errors.msg: The admin's key cannot be revoked

errors.name: AlreadyRevoked
errors.msg: This key is already revoked

errors.name: NotRevoked
errors.msg: This key is not revoked

errors.name: ListFull
errors.msg: The list is full

errors.name: AlreadyListed
errors.msg: The key is already on the list

errors.name: NotListed
errors.msg: The key is not on the list

errors.name: IntakeStopped
errors.msg: Intake is stopped: open_escrow and fund are refused until the stop is lifted or lapses

errors.name: PayoutStopped
errors.msg: Payouts are stopped: claim, refund, settle and arbiter_resolve are refused until the stop is lifted or lapses

errors.name: EscrowFrozen
errors.msg: The guardian has frozen this escrow: claim, refund, settle and arbiter_resolve are refused until the admin unfreezes it or the freeze lapses

errors.name: NotAnEscalation
errors.msg: The guardian may only raise the stop level

errors.name: NotStopped
errors.msg: No stop is in force

errors.name: AlreadyFrozen
errors.msg: This escrow is already frozen

errors.name: NotFrozen
errors.msg: This escrow is not frozen

errors.name: MintNotAllowed
errors.msg: The mint is not on the config's mint allowlist

errors.name: SponsorNotAllowed
errors.msg: The sponsor is not on the config's sponsor allowlist

errors.name: RefundToNotSponsor
errors.msg: refund_to must be the sponsor

errors.name: ArbiterNotConfig
errors.msg: The arbiter must be the config's arbiter

errors.name: ComplianceRequired
errors.msg: A compliance key is required

errors.name: BondBelowMin
errors.msg: The bond is below the config's minimum bond

errors.name: WindowBelowFloor
errors.msg: A window is below the config's floor for it

errors.name: RegraderNotRegistered
errors.msg: A regrader is not in the config's regrader registry

errors.name: TooManyHouseRegraders
errors.msg: More house regraders than the config allows

errors.name: RegraderNotIndependent
errors.msg: The resolver and the compliance key cannot be regraders

errors.name: EscrowCapExceeded
errors.msg: The escrow would hold more than the config's per-escrow cap

errors.name: GlobalCapExceeded
errors.msg: Open escrows would hold more than the config's global cap

errors.name: FlowLimitExceeded
errors.msg: The claim is over what the flow limit allows now: claim less, or wait for the bucket to refill

errors.name: VaultFrozen
errors.msg: The escrow's vault token account is frozen by the mint's freeze authority

errors.name: ClaimantAccountFrozen
errors.msg: The claimant's token account is frozen by the mint's freeze authority

errors.name: RefundAccountFrozen
errors.msg: refund_to's token account is frozen by the mint's freeze authority

errors.name: SponsorAccountFrozen
errors.msg: The sponsor's token account is frozen by the mint's freeze authority

errors.name: CommitMismatch
errors.msg: The reveal does not match the commit: sha256(alt_commitment || challenger || salt) differs

errors.name: RevealTooEarly
errors.msg: A reveal must land in a slot after its commit's

errors.name: RevealWindowClosed
errors.msg: The reveal window (challenge_deadline + reveal_grace) has closed

errors.name: CommitsPendingReveal
errors.msg: A committed challenge may still be revealed: settle waits for challenge_deadline + reveal_grace

errors.name: RoleMismatch
errors.msg: The key is not this escrow's holder of that role

errors.name: RegraderAlreadyVoted
errors.msg: This regrader has already voted: its seat cannot be rotated

errors.name: QuorumRecorded
errors.msg: The dispute's quorum is recorded and binds: settle applies it, so the escrow is never refunded from Disputed, nor escalated once settle may apply it

errors.name: OverturnWindowOpen
errors.msg: An alternative a quorum backed overturns the posted result only once the attest window has ended (attest_deadline): until then the guardian may escalate it to the arbiter

errors.name: RoleIsEscrow
errors.msg: The resolver and the compliance key cannot be the escrow's own address, which never signs

errors.name: NoEntries
errors.msg: An entries root commits at least one entry: entries_count is zero

errors.name: UnchallengedResultBinds
errors.msg: The posted result's challenge window is over with no challenge: the result binds (settle makes it Claimable), so it is no longer escalated

errors.name: PanelTooSmall
errors.msg: The escrow names fewer regraders than the config's min_regraders

types.name: AllowList
docs: Which allowlist set_allowed edits.

types.name: ArbiterChoice
docs: Which result arbiter_resolve applies to a Frozen escrow: the arbiter picks a side, it never
writes a result of its own.

types.name: ArbiterResolved
docs: arbiter_resolve: the arbiter chose which result of a Frozen escrow applies, the posted one or
one challenge's.

fields.name: payout_root
docs: The chosen side's result, now in force.

fields.name: commitment
docs: result_commitment(result_sha256, payout_root, total): the chosen (winning) commitment.

fields.name: challenge
docs: The chosen Challenge PDA; Pubkey::default() when the posted result was chosen.

fields.name: challenger
docs: Its challenger; Pubkey::default() when the posted result was chosen.

fields.name: resolver_paid
docs: Lamports paid to the resolver (every bond when the posted result was chosen; 0 otherwise).

fields.name: challenger_paid
docs: Lamports paid to the chosen challenger (every bond when it was chosen; 0 otherwise).

types.name: AttestSide
docs: Which result an attestation backs.

types.name: Attestation
docs: One regrader's vote in a dispute. PDA: `["attestation", escrow, regrader]`, so each regrader
votes once per escrow. The regrader pays its rent; close_attestation returns it to the
regrader once the escrow is Closed, when no instruction reads a vote any more.

fields.name: regrader
docs: The regrader who voted and paid the rent (a PDA seed): close_attestation's rent goes to it.

fields.name: commitment
docs: The result commitment the regrader rebuilt (document hash, payout root and total): the
posted one (Result) or one challenge's (Alt).

types.name: AttestationClosed
docs: close_attestation: a vote's Attestation was closed once its escrow was Closed, its rent
returned to its regrader.

fields.name: commitment
docs: The commitment the vote named, and its side.

types.name: Attested
docs: attest: a regrader voted.

fields.name: commitment
docs: The commitment the regrader backed: the posted one (Result) or one challenge's (Alt).

fields.name: challenge
docs: The Challenge PDA whose commitment it backed; Pubkey::default() for the posted result.

fields.name: votes
docs: The votes its commitment holds now.

fields.name: quorum
docs: Whether this vote took its commitment to k: the side that wins, which settle applies.

fields.name: votes_alt
docs: Votes for every challenge's commitment together.

types.name: ChallengeClosed
docs: close_challenge: a Challenge PDA of a decided or refunded escrow was closed, its rent (and,
after a refund that decided nothing, its bond) returned to its challenger.

fields.name: bond_returned
docs: Lamports of its bond returned: only after a refund that decided nothing (once a side
wins, settle or arbiter_resolve pays every bond to it).

fields.name: rent_returned
docs: Lamports of the account's rent returned.

types.name: ChallengeCommitted
docs: challenge_commit: a challenger bonded a commit to an alternative it reveals later.

fields.name: commit
docs: The CommitRecord PDA, ["commit", escrow, challenger, hash].

fields.name: hash
docs: sha256(alt_commitment || challenger || salt).

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot it landed in: its reveal must land in a later one.

fields.name: committed_at
docs: The escrow clock when it landed.

fields.name: pending_commits
docs: The escrow's commits not yet revealed or closed, this one included.

types.name: ChallengeRecord
docs: One challenge of an escrow: a bonded alternative result (document hash, payout root and
total). PDA: `["challenge", escrow, alt_commitment]`, so an escrow takes one challenge per
distinct alternative, and a junk challenge never keeps another alternative out. Its bond sits
in the escrow account with the others (Escrow.challenger_bond); this account holds its rent,
which close_challenge returns to `challenger` once the dispute is over.

fields.name: challenger
docs: Signed the challenge and paid its bond and this account's rent.

fields.name: alt_commitment
docs: result_commitment(alt_result_sha256, alt_payout_root, alt_total): the PDA's seed.

fields.name: bond
docs: The lamports of bond it paid (the escrow's bond_lamports).

fields.name: opened_at
docs: Unix seconds it landed.

fields.name: index
docs: Its place among the escrow's challenges, from 0 (the one that opened the dispute).

fields.name: votes
docs: Regraders who voted its commitment.

types.name: Challenged
docs: challenge_reveal: a revealed commit's bonded alternative result (document hash, payout root
and total) opened its Challenge PDA, and the dispute (the first) or joined it (a later one).

fields.name: commit
docs: The CommitRecord PDA revealed (and closed).

fields.name: challenge
docs: The Challenge PDA, ["challenge", escrow, alt_commitment].

fields.name: commitment
docs: The posted result's commitment.

fields.name: alt_commitment
docs: result_commitment(alt_result_sha256, alt_payout_root, alt_total).

fields.name: challenger_bond
docs: This challenge's bond.

fields.name: index
docs: Its Challenge.index: 0 for the one that opened the dispute.

fields.name: challenge_count
docs: The escrow's challenge_count after it.

fields.name: attest_deadline
docs: challenge_deadline + attest_window, set by the first challenge; a later one leaves it.

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: One claimant's progress against one escrow. PDA: `["claim", escrow, claimant]`.

fields.name: total_amount
docs: The leaf amount the claimant proved.

fields.name: requested_at
docs: Unix seconds of request_claim; 0 when never requested.

fields.name: hold_reason
docs: HOLD_NONE, or the HOLD_* reason of the hold in force.

fields.name: held_at
docs: Unix seconds the hold in force was placed; 0 when none.

types.name: ClaimRequested
docs: request_claim: the claimant proved a leaf and started the hold window.

fields.name: clears_at
docs: requested_at + hold_window: when the claim clears if no hold is placed.

types.name: Claimed
docs: claim: tokens moved from the vault to the claimant.

fields.name: cosigned
docs: Whether the compliance key co-signed (false: the claim cleared by a lapsed request, or
the escrow has no compliance gate).

types.name: CommitClosed
docs: close_commit: a commit never revealed was closed once its escrow decided, its bond and rent
returned to its own challenger.

fields.name: pending_commits
docs: The escrow's commits still pending after it.

types.name: CommitRecord
docs: A committed challenge, not yet revealed. PDA: `["commit", escrow, challenger, hash]`. Its bond
sits in the escrow account (Escrow.commit_bond); this account holds its rent. challenge_reveal
closes it into a ChallengeRecord (its rent back to the challenger); one never revealed is
closed by close_commit once the escrow has decided, its bond and rent back to its own
challenger.

fields.name: challenger
docs: Signed the commit and paid its bond and this account's rent.

fields.name: hash
docs: commit_hash(alt_commitment, challenger, salt).

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot it landed in: a reveal must land in a later one.

fields.name: committed_at
docs: The escrow clock when it landed.

fields.name: bond
docs: The lamports of bond it paid (the escrow's bond_lamports).

types.name: Config
docs: The program's Config. PDA: `["config"]`. Created once by the upgrade authority; every setter
is the admin's, except the guardian's escalation verbs (set_stop up, set_freeze on, escalate,
set_revoked on), which the admin may use too.

fields.name: stop
docs: The breaker level as last set; it lapses to Normal at stop_expires_at (stop_level reads it).

fields.name: max_house_regraders
docs: The most house regraders one escrow may name.

fields.name: admin
docs: Sets everything; today the owner's key, later the upgrade multisig vault.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: The key propose_admin named, which accept_admin makes the admin; Pubkey::default() when
none is pending.

fields.name: guardian
docs: The guardian: a separate key, never on the server, that may only escalate.

fields.name: arbiter
docs: The arbiter every escrow names and arbiter_resolve answers to; today the owner's key, later
the multisig vault.

fields.name: escrow_cap
docs: C_e, in mint base units.

fields.name: global_cap
docs: C_g, in mint base units.

fields.name: open_value
docs: What every escrow not yet refunded deposited (open_escrow and fund add, refund takes away).

fields.name: flow_level
docs: The bucket as of flow_updated_at (wall time); claim refills it, then takes from it.

fields.name: stop_since
docs: Wall time the stop in force was set (meaningful while `stop` is not Normal).

fields.name: stop_expires_at
docs: Wall time the stop in force lapses.

fields.name: stopped_secs
docs: Seconds of every PayoutStop that has ended: G before the one in force.

fields.name: min_regraders
docs: The fewest regraders an escrow may name (open_escrow's PanelTooSmall): DEFAULT_MIN_REGRADERS
at initialize_config, 1 to MAX_REGRADERS by set_min_regraders. It takes the first of the
bytes `reserved` held, so a Config written before it reads 0 here, which refuses no panel
(every panel names at least one regrader), as 1 does.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zeroed room for later fields.

types.name: ConfigChange
docs: What a ConfigChanged event records.

types.name: ConfigChanged
docs: Every Config change but the stop and the revocations (StopChanged, RevocationChanged): what
changed, the key it names, and Config's settings after it.

fields.name: by
docs: The signer: the upgrade authority (Initialized), the proposed admin (AdminAccepted), or the
admin.

fields.name: key
docs: The key the change names (the new admin, guardian or arbiter, the listed key);
Pubkey::default() otherwise.

fields.name: list
docs: The list it edits (Allowed, Disallowed); None otherwise.

fields.name: house
docs: The regrader's house flag (Allowed of a regrader); false otherwise.

fields.name: min_regraders
docs: The panel floor open_escrow holds escrows to (0 on a Config written before the field: it
refuses no panel, as 1 does).

types.name: ConfigInit
docs: What initialize_config writes: the keys, the limits, the floors and the starting lists.

types.name: ConfigRole
docs: Which Config key set_config_role replaces (the admin moves by propose_admin and accept_admin).

types.name: EntriesCommitted
docs: commit_entries: the entries root is fixed.

types.name: Escalated
docs: escalate: the guardian (or the admin) handed an undecided escrow to the arbiter, Frozen.

fields.name: from_status
docs: Challengeable (inside its challenge window) or Disputed (before a recorded quorum binds).

types.name: Escrow
docs: One competition's prize escrow. PDA: `["escrow", sponsor, competition_id]`. Its vault is the
associated token account of (this account, mint) under the classic Token program.

fields.name: k
docs: Attestations needed to settle a dispute.

fields.name: n
docs: How many of `regraders` are set.

fields.name: competition_id
docs: The competition's 16-byte UUID, a PDA seed after the sponsor.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Opened and funded the escrow; a PDA seed.

fields.name: compliance
docs: Pubkey::default() when there is no compliance gate.

fields.name: challenger
docs: The challenger whose alternative won: attest records it when the regraders' votes for its
commitment reach k, arbiter_resolve when the arbiter chooses it. Pubkey::default() until
one does, and again once the arbiter keeps the posted result over a recorded one
(Escrow::clear_alternative): it never names a losing alternative's challenger (every
challenge's own challenger is in its Challenge PDA).

fields.name: payout_root
docs: The root claims verify against: the posted one, or the winning alternative's once a quorum
(settle) or the arbiter (arbiter_resolve) applied it.

fields.name: kit_sha256
docs: The posted regrade kit's hash; applying an alternative leaves it as posted.

fields.name: commitment
docs: result_commitment(result_sha256, payout_root, total) of the result in force (the posted
one, or the applied alternative's); while Disputed, attest votes Result on it.

fields.name: alt_result_sha256
docs: The winning challenge's alternative (the `challenger`'s): its document hash, payout root
and commitment, copied from its Challenge PDA when its votes reach k or the arbiter
chooses it; all zero until then, and zeroed again with `challenger` when the arbiter keeps
the posted result instead. attest votes Alt on a Challenge's alt_commitment.

fields.name: challenge_count
docs: Challenges opened, each its own Challenge PDA (Challenge.index counts from 0).

fields.name: total
docs: The pot in mint base units: the opened deposit until post_result, then the posted (or the
applied alternative's) total, at most the vault balance, which caps what all claims take
together.

fields.name: alt_total
docs: The winning challenge's alternative total; 0 until one wins (and again once the arbiter
keeps the posted result over it).

fields.name: bond_lamports
docs: The bond, in lamports, a result or a challenge must post.

fields.name: resolver_bond
docs: Lamports of the resolver's bond held in this account.

fields.name: challenger_bond
docs: Lamports of every challenger's bond held in this account (bond_lamports per challenge): all
of them go to the winning side when settle or the arbiter decides the dispute; a refund
that decided nothing leaves them for close_challenge to return, each to its payer.

fields.name: final_end
docs: The final phase's end: post_result lands at or after it.

fields.name: votes_result
docs: Regraders who voted the posted commitment.

fields.name: votes_alt
docs: Regraders who voted a challenge's commitment, every challenge together (each Challenge
counts its own).

fields.name: regraders
docs: The first `n` slots are the regraders; the rest are Pubkey::default().

fields.name: deposited
docs: What open_escrow and fund moved into the vault: held to Config.escrow_cap, and what refund
takes back off Config.open_value.

fields.name: stop_base
docs: Config's global stopped seconds (G) when the escrow opened: only a PayoutStop after it
stops this escrow's clock (config::escrow_now).

fields.name: freeze_since
docs: The global clock (Γ) when the guardian's freeze in force began; 0 with none.

fields.name: freeze_until
docs: The global clock (Γ) at which that freeze lapses; 0 with no freeze on record.

fields.name: frozen_secs
docs: Seconds (on the global clock) of every freeze that has ended.

fields.name: reveal_grace
docs: Seconds after challenge_deadline a committed challenge may still be revealed (Config's
reveal_grace at open).

fields.name: commit_bond
docs: Lamports of the bonds of commits not yet revealed, held in this account apart from the
challenge bonds: close_commit returns each to its own challenger.

fields.name: pending_commits
docs: Commits not yet revealed or closed: settle waits for challenge_deadline + reveal_grace
while any could still be revealed.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zeroed room for later fields.

types.name: EscrowFunded
docs: fund: the sponsor topped up the vault.

types.name: EscrowOpened
docs: open_escrow: the escrow exists and its vault holds `total`.

types.name: EscrowRole
docs: Which of an escrow's keys rotate_role replaces.

types.name: EscrowStatus
docs: Where an escrow is in its life. Every instruction names the statuses it accepts.
post_result moves Open to Challengeable. From there settle (no challenge) makes it Claimable,
or the first challenge makes it Disputed (later ones, each a distinct alternative, join the
dispute), which settle ends as Claimable (the side a quorum of regraders backed applies) or
Frozen (no quorum). arbiter_resolve moves Frozen to Claimable on the side it chooses, and
refund moves any status to Closed.

types.name: EscrowTerms
docs: The terms open_escrow fixes for the escrow's whole life (the competition id is its own
argument, because it seeds the PDA with the sponsor).

fields.name: total
docs: The prize pot in mint base units, moved into the vault at open.

fields.name: rules_sha256
docs: sha256 of the competition's published rules.

fields.name: resolver
docs: Commits the entries root and posts the result.

fields.name: compliance
docs: Co-signs claims and places holds; Pubkey::default() means no compliance gate.

fields.name: arbiter
docs: Resolves a Frozen escrow (a Squads v4 vault PDA, which can only sign through the
multisig's CPI).

fields.name: refund_to
docs: Receives refunds (the vault's leftovers and its rent). A forfeited bond goes to the side
that won, never here.

fields.name: regraders
docs: The pre-named regraders, 1 to MAX_REGRADERS distinct keys; n is their count.

fields.name: k
docs: Attestations needed to settle a dispute: 1 <= k <= n and 2k > n.

fields.name: bond_lamports
docs: The SOL bond (lamports) the resolver posts with a result and a challenger posts with a
challenge; at least bond_floor (BOND_FLOOR_RENTS rent-exempt minimums of an empty account).

fields.name: entries_deadline
docs: Unix seconds: commit_entries must land before it (the final phase's start).

fields.name: final_end
docs: Unix seconds: the final phase's end. post_result lands at or after it, never on a
competition still running.

fields.name: resolve_deadline
docs: Unix seconds: post_result must land before it, or the pot can be refunded in full.

fields.name: challenge_window
docs: Seconds a posted result stays challengeable (at least MIN_CHALLENGE_WINDOW).

fields.name: attest_window
docs: Seconds regraders have to attest once the challenge window has closed (at least
MIN_ATTEST_WINDOW): attest_deadline is challenge_deadline + attest_window, set by the first
challenge however early in the challenge window it lands. Regraders may vote from that
challenge on, until attest_deadline.

fields.name: hold_window
docs: Seconds after request_claim before an unheld claim clears without the compliance
co-signature (at least MIN_HOLD_WINDOW).

fields.name: claim_window
docs: Seconds winners have to claim once the escrow is Claimable: at least MIN_CLAIM_WINDOW, and
longer than hold_window when a compliance key is set.

fields.name: hard_deadline
docs: Unix seconds after which anyone may refund an escrow that is not Claimable, whatever its
status (a Claimable one refunds only after its claim_deadline).

types.name: Floors
docs: The window floors open_escrow holds the terms to, on top of the compiled minimums, and the
reveal grace every escrow opened after it takes (set_floors).

fields.name: reveal_grace
docs: Seconds after challenge_deadline a challenge committed before it may still be revealed:
MIN_REVEAL_GRACE to MAX_REVEAL_GRACE.

types.name: FreezeChanged
docs: set_freeze or extend_freeze: the guardian froze an escrow, the admin unfroze it, or the admin
moved the freeze's lapse.

fields.name: freeze_since
docs: On the global clock: when the freeze in force began and lapses (0 when unfrozen).

fields.name: frozen_secs
docs: Seconds of every freeze that has ended.

fields.name: escrow_now
docs: The escrow clock now.

types.name: HoldPlaced
docs: hold: the compliance key held a claimant's claim.

types.name: HoldReleased
docs: release_hold: the compliance key released a hold.

fields.name: reason
docs: The reason of the hold that was released.

types.name: Limits
docs: The caps, the flow bucket, the bond minimum and the house-regrader allowance (set_limits).

fields.name: escrow_cap
docs: C_e: the most one escrow may hold (what open_escrow and fund deposited), in mint base units.

fields.name: global_cap
docs: C_g: the most every escrow not yet refunded may hold together (Config.open_value).

fields.name: flow_capacity
docs: The flow bucket's capacity: the most claims may pay out in a burst.

fields.name: flow_period
docs: Seconds the bucket takes to refill from empty to flow_capacity.

fields.name: min_bond
docs: The smallest bond_lamports open_escrow accepts (on top of the rent floor).

fields.name: max_house_regraders
docs: The most house regraders one escrow may name (MAX_REGRADERS allows an all-house panel).

types.name: ReceiptClosed
docs: close_receipt: a claimant reclaimed a receipt's rent after the escrow closed.

types.name: Refunded
docs: refund: the vault was swept to refund_to and the escrow is Closed.

fields.name: from_status
docs: The status the escrow was refunded from.

fields.name: resolver_paid
docs: Lamports of the resolver's bond returned to it (a bond no settle or arbiter paid out).

fields.name: challenger_bonds_held
docs: Lamports of challengers' bonds left in the escrow for close_challenge to return, each to
its payer (no side was proven); 0 once a side won.

types.name: RegraderEntry
docs: One key of the regrader registry: `house` marks a key the house holds (open_escrow counts them
against Config.max_house_regraders).

types.name: ResultPosted
docs: post_result: the resolver posted the result with its bond.

fields.name: commitment
docs: result_commitment(result_sha256, payout_root, total).

types.name: RevocationChanged
docs: set_revoked: a key's signature is refused everywhere (revoked), or accepted again.

fields.name: revoked_count
docs: How many keys are revoked after it.

types.name: RoleRotated
docs: rotate_role: the admin replaced one of an escrow's keys.

types.name: SettleOutcome
docs: How settle ended a challenge window or a dispute.

types.name: Settled
docs: settle: the challenge window or the dispute ended.

fields.name: claim_deadline
docs: Set when the escrow became Claimable; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: result_sha256
docs: The result in force after settle, its commitment the winning one: the posted result, or
the winning challenge's alternative after AltApplied (still the posted one after NoQuorum,
which no side won, until the arbiter chooses).

fields.name: challenger
docs: The winning challenge's challenger after AltApplied; Pubkey::default() otherwise.

fields.name: resolver_paid
docs: Lamports paid to the resolver (its bond, plus every challenger's after ResultUpheld).

fields.name: challenger_paid
docs: Lamports paid to the winning challenger (every bond after AltApplied; 0 otherwise).

types.name: StopChanged
docs: set_stop or extend_stop: the breaker level changed or its lapse moved.

fields.name: by
docs: The guardian (escalating) or the admin.

fields.name: from
docs: The level in force before.

fields.name: stopped_secs
docs: Seconds of every PayoutStop that has ended.

types.name: StopState
docs: The breaker level Config holds. The levels are ordered: PayoutStop includes IntakeStop, so the
guardian, who may only escalate, moves Normal -> IntakeStop -> PayoutStop and never back.

constants.name: ARBITER_SLACK
docs: What open_escrow adds after every window to find the earliest hard_deadline it accepts, in
seconds: 7 days for a delayed arbiter_resolve (a Squads proposal and its time lock). With
hard_deadline >= resolve_deadline + challenge + attest + hold + claim windows + this slack, an
escrow that runs its course on time is Claimable well inside hard_deadline; a later arbiter
still leaves its claims a whole claim window (refund waits for claim_deadline).

constants.name: ATTESTATION_SEED
docs: Seed of an Attestation PDA: `["attestation", escrow, regrader]`.

constants.name: BOND_FLOOR_RENTS
docs: The bond floor, in rent-exempt minimums of an empty account: open_escrow takes a bond_lamports
of at least BOND_FLOOR_RENTS x Rent::minimum_balance(0) (state::bond_floor), read from the Rent
sysvar, so the floor follows the cluster's rent. A bond that size is never dust, and any one
bond paid out leaves its recipient rent-exempt even if it held nothing before.

constants.name: CHALLENGE_SEED
docs: Seed of a Challenge PDA: `["challenge", escrow, alt_commitment]`, so an escrow holds one
challenge per distinct alternative commitment.

constants.name: CLAIM_SEED
docs: Seed of a ClaimReceipt PDA: `["claim", escrow, claimant]`.

constants.name: COMMIT_SEED
docs: Seed of a CommitRecord PDA: `["commit", escrow, challenger, hash]`, hash being
`sha256(alt_commitment || challenger || salt)`. The challenger is in the seeds, so a copy of
someone else's hash lands at another address and never blocks the original.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: Seed of the Config PDA: `["config"]`, one per program, created once by the program's upgrade
authority (initialize_config).

constants.name: DEFAULT_MIN_REGRADERS
docs: The panel floor a new Config starts with (Config.min_regraders): 1, the smallest panel
EscrowTerms::validate accepts anyway (owner decision #541: single keys for now). The admin
raises it with set_min_regraders, up to MAX_REGRADERS, without an upgrade.

constants.name: ESCROW_SEED
docs: Seed of the Escrow PDA: `["escrow", sponsor, competition_id]`, competition_id being the
competition's 16-byte UUID. The sponsor in the seeds means nobody else can open a sponsor's
competition first and squat its address.

constants.name: HOLD_GEO
docs: ClaimReceipt.hold_reason: a blocked geography.

constants.name: HOLD_NONE
docs: ClaimReceipt.hold_reason: no hold.

constants.name: HOLD_REVIEW
docs: ClaimReceipt.hold_reason: a manual review.

constants.name: HOLD_SANCTIONS
docs: ClaimReceipt.hold_reason: a sanctions-list match.

constants.name: HOLD_TAX_FORM_REQUIRED
docs: ClaimReceipt.hold_reason: a tax form (W-9) is required before payment.

constants.name: MAX_PROOF_LEN
docs: The longest merkle proof claim and request_claim accept (2^24 leaves).

constants.name: MAX_REGRADERS
docs: The most regraders an escrow names; Escrow.regraders holds this many slots.

constants.name: MAX_REVEAL_GRACE
docs: The longest reveal grace Config accepts, in seconds: 6 h (30 s under `test-windows`). It stays
below every attest window open_escrow accepts, so a reveal on the grace's last second still
leaves the regraders time to vote before attest_deadline.

constants.name: MAX_WINDOW
docs: The longest window open_escrow accepts, in seconds (i32::MAX, about 68 years): deadline
arithmetic on any accepted window cannot overflow, and every window fits the server's 32-bit
*_window_seconds columns.

constants.name: MIN_ATTEST_WINDOW
docs: The shortest attestation window open_escrow accepts, in seconds: 48 h (60 s under
`test-windows`).

constants.name: MIN_CHALLENGE_WINDOW
docs: The shortest challenge window open_escrow accepts, in seconds: 72 h. The `test-windows`
feature (localnet and devnet builds only) lowers it to 60 s.

constants.name: MIN_CLAIM_WINDOW
docs: The shortest claim window open_escrow accepts, in seconds: 7 days, so winners always get a
week to claim before refund may sweep their prizes. The `test-windows` feature lowers it to
90 s, still longer than that build's 60 s hold window.

constants.name: MIN_HOLD_WINDOW
docs: The shortest compliance hold window open_escrow accepts, in seconds: 72 h (60 s under
`test-windows`). A requested claim with no on-chain hold clears once it passes.

constants.name: MIN_REVEAL_GRACE
docs: The shortest reveal grace Config accepts, in seconds: how long after challenge_deadline a
challenge committed before it may still be revealed. 5 minutes (5 s under `test-windows`).

constants.name: RESULT_COMMITMENT_DOMAIN
docs: Domain of the result commitment post_result stores, each challenge seeds its PDA with, and
attest and arbiter_resolve compare:
`sha256(RESULT_COMMITMENT_DOMAIN || result_sha256 || payout_root || u64le(total))`
(state::result_commitment; server/chain/result.ts resultCommitment).

constants.name: STOP_DURATION
docs: How long one stop (Config's IntakeStop or PayoutStop) or one guardian freeze of an escrow lasts
before it lapses on its own, in seconds: 7 days. Only the admin extends one in force
(extend_stop, extend_freeze), but the length is per raise, not a ceiling: once one lapses the
guardian may raise it again, and so hold the program (or one escrow) for as long as it keeps
renewing, until the admin replaces or revokes the guardian's key (breakers.rs).
